name: The Legend of Stalvan
label: Quest
description: The Legend of Stalvan: the quest giver's words, read aloud by the Lore Forever narrators.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: Stalvan Mistmantle led a life of depravity. Innocent victims died by his hand. Undoubtedly he is guilty of countless crimes. Now the lunatic threatens Darkshire. The Light only knows what sordid acts he is plotting. Travel to his cottage just north of town, adventurer, and execute Stalvan, once and for all.
When the deed is done, travel to Madame Eva's and show her his family ring. After all, it was her premonition that led to this gruesome discovery. But Darkshire is safer because of her.

clips.title: Completion
paras: I know, friend: Stalvan is dead. I sensed a wave of hope ripple through the tainted forest. Once and for all, Duskwood is free from his blood thirst. My joy is hampered by thoughts of those who fell prey to the horrible beast. Nonetheless, you are a brave and cunning adventurer.

sources.title: Forever's own quest text, captured in game
